headings.usage: Dashboard titles, KPI primary numbers, Section headers. Avoid Inter. Use tracking-tight for sizes above 32px.

body.usage: Data tables, charts, labels, nav items. Provides a highly readable, technical feel suited for dense data.

rules: Use monochrome layout mainly. Colors exist only to guide action or indicate status (success/warning/destructive).
Avoid muddy gray transparency. No fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.
Ensure text meets APCA contrast standards. Never use pure #000000 or #808080.

visual_enhancers.borders: Visible grid skeletons. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border).
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness, max 4px to 8px border-radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Gives a sharp, functional look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid soft UI everywhere. Hover states can have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and a sharp, small shadow.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat, solid colors for readability in data.

rules: DO NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions.
Go cardless or use rectangular, dense styles where possible for the data grid.
Tables: Compact row height (32-40px), sticky header, zebra stripes on hover only.
KPI Cards: Include label, tabular numeral value, delta (+/- comparison), and no static decoration-only tiles.
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

layouts.app_shell: Fixed left sidebar (navigation) + Topbar (global search, user profile) + Main Content Area.
layouts.f_pattern: Place the most critical North Star metric or KPI at the top left quadrant.
layouts.navigation: Role-based menus (SuperAdmin, Admin, Sales). Highlight active route. Sidebar links must have icons.
layouts.spacing: Dense but legible. Generous padding around the main container (p-6 or p-8), tighter padding inside cards (p-4).

rules: Minimalist for dashboards. Focus on micro-interactions for feedback.
No generic transition-all. Use specific properties: transition-transform, transition-colors, transition-opacity.
Hover states must change color (lighter hue of active state) or subtle lift.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Focus states must have higher contrast than default.

login_background.description: Swiss architecture monochrome for the auth page split background

user_avatar.description: Professional portrait for topbar user avatar (woman in white shirt)

3d_libraries.rules: Not applicable for this data-dense admin dashboard. Use Recharts via Shadcn for trend charts (Sales, Customers, Expenses).

specific_instructions.language: Bahasa Indonesia MUST be used for UI text (Penjualan, Pelanggan, Pengeluaran, Harian, Mingguan, Bulanan, etc).
specific_instructions.role_based_access: Ensure route guards and conditional rendering of sidebar items based on role (SuperAdmin, Admin, Sales).
specific_instructions.states: Implement clear Loading, Empty, and Error states for tables and charts. Do not leave blank spaces.
specific_instructions.charts: Trend charts must have time-range filters (Harian, Mingguan, Bulanan). Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
Create data-testid attributes for all form inputs, buttons, and navigation items to facilitate testing.
